`docs/threat-model.md` lists two parsers of untrusted input that no fuzz target reads: the Turtle scanner in `src/manifest.c`, which reads each `manifest.ttl` of the search path, and the JSON parser in `src/json.c`, which reads the store's layer files and the `put` bodies.
